The '''Red Sector''' was a section of the inner areas of [[Nirama's public asteroid]]. Red Sector had a troublesome reputation among the station's security forces.

Buildings contained within the sector included the [[Hutt's Tail]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and three storage facilities, the middle of which was used by [[the Cell]] for meetings with potential recruits. Red Sector was not used during the graveyard shift and the Cell had deactivated the visual sensors of the simple [[Droid/Legends|droids]] which worked the storage facilities at night.

Security details working Red Sector were expected to sweep the area three times in an eight-hour shift, with a full sweep taking forty minutes.
